assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0).
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness.
The dizziness and giddiness are concerning for potential arrhythmia.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The diagnosis code I34.0 corresponds to nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The mobile cardiac telemetry addresses the medical necessity question raised by the CO-197 precertification denial.
The claim for Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) has been denied.
The denial is based on Reason Code CO-197.
The required precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
SilverBridge Advantage requires all non-emergency diagnostic monitoring services to be pre-approved.
The provider may submit a formal appeal within ninety days of the notice.
